summary: Make API pacing cancelable and serialized, remove API-owned transcript, attendee, and folder-membership rows after a complete sync confirms a note is missing, and honor date-only audit cutoffs for a full calendar day.
reason: Canceled calls could wait out a rate limiter and concurrent calls could race through it. A removed API note could leave dependent rows visible through direct queries. A date-only audit filter incorrectly used the current time of day at its one-year boundary.
validated_outcome: Synthetic tests cover cancellation, concurrent pacing, date-only audit boundaries, deletion of only API-owned transcript, attendee, and folder-membership rows after complete reconciliation, rollback when a dependent-row deletion fails, and successful reconciliation after an injected real stale WAL snapshot forces a retry. Candidate selection and deletion share one transaction.
